environment_encoding: integer mask 0..15; coordinate j is +1 iff bit j is one, otherwise -1

selectors.active: lexicographically tie-broken candidate minimizing next-step R^2 on the registered deployment family
selectors.space_filling: lexicographically tie-broken candidate maximizing minimum Hamming distance to already selected environments; mask zero at step one

numeric_contract.ordering_scope: global minimum under rounded numerical contract; no exact ordering claim within a tie bin
numeric_contract.exact_witness_backend: sympy Rational for deterministic selected minimum and selector designs

scientific_thresholds.auc_definition: arithmetic mean of R^2/11 over scientific_budgets

instrument_gates.coordinate_reframings: all 384 signed coordinate permutations on registered representative designs
instrument_gates.monotonicity: R^2 must not increase on any one-environment subset-lattice extension

prohibited_claims: No semiparametric necessity or sufficiency theorem.
No universal active-design optimality or exact within-tie-bin ordering claim.
